authoritative_interface_audit.finding: The authoritative interface retains dom.html and visible-text.txt, but also captures a full-page screenshot and page resources per row.
authoritative_interface_audit.decision: Use a narrower content-only GET addendum for 732 frozen URLs to avoid duplicating visual evidence and page-resource capture; preserve exact raw HTML, visible-text hashes, response provenance, and separately hashed sanitized fragments.
